name: The Cult Tech Dream
partSub: Dark rooms, neon rigs, and the 7:00 PM Bangalore rush

lines.text: Every evening at 7:00 PM in Bangalore, thousands of techies rush into dark, air-conditioned rooms with neon lighting, pulsing house beats, and charismatic trainers shouting encouragement.
lines.title: THE NEON FITNESS TEMPLE
lines.subtitle: House beats, synchronized movements, and Bangalore techies

lines.text: It looks less like a gym, and more like a high-energy tech concert. My name is Anurag Bansal, and welcome to Not a Startup.
lines.title: NOT A STARTUP EXCLUSIVE
lines.subtitle: My name is Anurag Bansal, let's decode the ₹2.2 Crore balance sheet

lines.text: Cult.fit revolutionized Indian fitness. No intimidating bodybuilders, no rusty iron weights. Just gamified app bookings, synchronized group workouts, and a massive brand halo.
lines.title: GAMIFIED FITNESS REVOLUTION
lines.subtitle: No rusty barbells—just app streaks, energy meters, and brand halo

lines.text: And if you are an investor with two crores in capital, their franchise pitch deck looks like an absolute money machine.
lines.title: THE ₹2 CRORE PROMISE
lines.subtitle: Franchise pitch deck promises predictable automated cash flow

lines.text: A 4,500 square-foot facility, 450 active subscribers, an average realization of ₹1,800 per month.
lines.title: TOP-LINE SUBSCRIPTION MATH
lines.subtitle: 4,500 sq ft · 450 active members · ₹1,800 monthly realization

lines.text: That is over eight lakh rupees every single month in automated subscription cash flow.
lines.title: ₹8.1 LAKHS MONTHLY REVENUE
lines.subtitle: Automated recurring UPI collections hitting the bank every month

name: The Upfront Fitout
partSub: Acoustic flooring, neon lighting rigs, and non-refundable fees

lines.text: But before a single member laces up their sneakers, your bank account takes a massive hit.
lines.title: DAY ZERO CAPITAL DRAIN
lines.subtitle: Before a single sneaker laces up, your bank account enters ICU

lines.text: First, a ₹20 Lakh non-refundable franchise fee. Then, the physical fitout: double-layered acoustic rubber flooring, soundproofed walls, high-lumen neon rig lighting, and locker rooms. That is ₹85 Lakhs.
lines.title: ₹1.05 CRORES UPFRONT FITOUT
lines.subtitle: ₹20L franchise fee + ₹85L acoustic flooring, neon rigs, and luxury showers

lines.text: Next comes the gear: concept-2 rowers, assault air bikes, custom pull-up rigs, and calibrated urethane dumbbells. Another ₹55 Lakhs.
lines.title: ₹55 LAKH HARDWARE ARSENAL
lines.subtitle: Concept-2 rowers, assault bikes, urethane dumbbells, and custom rigs

lines.text: Factor in pre-operative marketing, security deposits, and working capital, and you have invested ₹2.2 Crores before day one.
lines.title: ₹2.20 CRORES INVESTED
lines.subtitle: Pre-op marketing, security deposit, and equipment before Day 1

lines.text: To generate Cult-level footfalls, you cannot open in a quiet basement. You need a 4,500 square-foot floor plate on a high-street in Indiranagar, HSR Layout, or Whitefield.
lines.title: THE HIGH STREET REQUIREMENT
lines.subtitle: No quiet basements: 4,500 sq ft floor plate on 100ft Road or HSR Layout

lines.text: At ₹90 per square foot, your monthly rent is ₹4,05,000. And unlike gym members who can pause their memberships, your landlord expects his cheque on the first of every month.
lines.title: ₹4,05,000 / MONTH LEASE
lines.subtitle: ₹90/sq ft locked rent due on the 1st of every month without fail

name: The Electricity Shock
partSub: Commercial BESCOM tariffs, trainer wars, and Curefit platform royalty

lines.text: Cooling 4,500 square feet packed with forty sweaty athletes during an HRX session requires a 50-ton commercial HVAC system running sixteen hours a day.
lines.title: THE COOLING ARMAGEDDON
lines.subtitle: Cooling 40 sweaty techies during an HRX session 16 hours a day

lines.text: On Karnataka's non-domestic commercial tariff, your monthly power bill routinely crosses ₹1,40,000.
lines.title: ₹1,40,000 / MONTH BESCOM
lines.subtitle: Karnataka commercial tariff eats 17% of total monthly cash flow

lines.text: Cult's secret weapon has always been its charismatic trainers. But star trainers do not come cheap.
lines.title: THE CHARISMATIC COACH TRAP
lines.subtitle: Cult's secret weapon is charismatic trainers—and they don't come cheap

lines.text: Four certified Cult trainers and two support coaches will run you ₹2,50,000 a month. And if your lead trainer quits, twenty of your members walk out the door with them.
lines.title: ₹2,50,000 / MONTH PAYROLL
lines.subtitle: 4 Cult trainers + 2 coaches; if the lead coach quits, 20 members walk

lines.text: Then comes the platform tax. Cult.fit charges a 12% royalty on total collections for managing the app, marketing, and workout programming.
lines.title: THE 12% CUREFIT TAX
lines.subtitle: Cult.fit deducts 12% off top-line collections before you touch a rupee

lines.text: Plus, when Cult runs aggressive promotional sales on Cult Pass Elite, your per-session payout shrinks, but your operating costs remain locked in stone.
lines.title: PER-SESSION PAYOUT DILUTION
lines.subtitle: Cult Pass Elite discount campaigns shrink your per-session payout

name: The Annual Churn Collapse
partSub: The January illusion versus the brutal April ghost town

lines.text: Here is the dirty secret of Indian fitness: in January, your center is overflowing. By April, sixty percent of your members have stopped showing up.
lines.title: THE APRIL RESOLUTION CLIFF
lines.subtitle: Packed in January, but 60% of members vanish completely by April

lines.text: In a traditional gym, absentee members are pure profit. But in Cult's class-based model, if footfalls drop, your app utilization falls, and Curefit's algorithm begins deprioritizing your center.
lines.title: THE UTILIZATION PUNISHMENT
lines.subtitle: Unlike traditional gyms, lower footfalls cause Curefit to deprioritize you

lines.text: When you subtract rent, electricity, trainer payroll, equipment maintenance, and Curefit royalties from your eight lakhs in revenue, your true monthly net profit is just ₹1,35,000.
lines.title: ₹1,35,000 TRUE NET PROFIT
lines.subtitle: Subtract Rent (₹4.05L), BESCOM (₹1.4L), Payroll (₹2.5L), Royalty (₹97K)

lines.text: That is a 16% net margin for managing broken assault bikes, flooded shower rooms, and non-stop member complaints.
lines.title: A MEAGER 16% MARGIN
lines.subtitle: Managing broken assault bikes, flooded showers, and member anxiety

lines.text: At ₹1.35 Lakhs a month, it will take you fifty-four months—four and a half years—just to recover your initial capital. If you had simply parked that ₹2.2 Crores in senior debt or mutual funds, you would have made more money while sleeping through the night.
lines.title: 54-MONTH CAPITAL RECOVERY
lines.subtitle: Four and a half years just to break even; senior debt beats the return

lines.text: Cult.fit built a world-class consumer brand. But as a franchisee, you are not disrupting fitness. You are financing Curefit's real estate footprint with your own capital.
lines.title: WHO ACTUALLY WINS?
lines.subtitle: You are not disrupting fitness—you are financing Curefit's real estate footprint
